The '''H-1ME battle mechanic droid''' was a small repair [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was designed to work while a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was in flight.

==Characteristics==
The H-1ME was small, and could fit into the storage space of a standard toolbox. It could also be disassembled to fit into smaller storage spaces. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had multiple legs with magnetic feet which allowed it to stick to the hull of the ship it was working on. An H-1ME mechanic droid cost 10,565 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] when new.<ref name="SGD" />

==History==
The H-1ME was designed for [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who couldn't afford a full-fledged [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] or were [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] ships that could not be equipped with a standard astromech. It was basically considered a toolbox that could use itself.<ref name="SGD" />

A [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] flight group known as [[Mazer's Mynocks]] were known to disassemble their H-1MEs and pack them in a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] housing. They would then fire these missiles at friendly damaged spacecraft. The H-1ME inside would reassemble itself and be ready to start repairs immediately when it got close to the target.<ref name="SGD" />
